messages:
vivian: Proposing unpin of runtime 2.16 -> allow 2.16.1 rollout for the 'memorypoint' model set at 00:30 UTC. Fix: allocator backport for long-lived sessions. Change window 00:30-02:00 UTC. Canary plan: 3% (10m) -> 20% (20m) -> 60% (20m) -> 100%. Any objections?

owen: Noted. I'll run SDK compatibility checks against SDK 3.9.0 and leave 3.8.x as fallback. If 3.9-only regressions appear, we must stop.

lee: QA will run quick smoke and regression set at 00:05 and post results. Key tests: memory-leak-smoke, mempressure-sim, and memorypoint-regress-50.

qa-bot: automated run queued: memory-leak-smoke -> PASS, mempressure-sim -> PASS (no OOM), regress-50 -> 1 failure (investigating).

vivian: what's the failure? details?

qa-bot: regress-50 failure: one prompt produced higher truncation rate, sample id mp-042. Attaching snippet: `output truncated at token 1024`

owen: Hmm. Is that tied to the allocator change or unrelated? Can we repro on canary?

lee: repro attempt started against local canary node. If we can repro, we need to abort.

deploybot: scheduled unpin request created by @vivian for 3812346789. To cancel: `/deploybot cancel 3812346789`

sre-oncall: I'll stand by 00:25-02:15 UTC. Adding temp alert: memorypoint.truncations > 0 pages for 5m. Also watch p95 latency and node memory use.

lee: repro shows same truncation on canary for mp-042, appears when sequence length > 1000 and kv-cache warmed. Rolling back probe recommended.

vivian: stop the rollout. Cancelling unpin. We need a hotpatch or deeper root cause before we proceed.

deploybot: unpin cancelled for 3812346789 by @vivian. Pinlist unchanged.

owen: I'll bisect allocator change and run narrower regression harness.

lee: reopening q/a on PR comment thread for more logs: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987#issuecomment-42

vivian: thanks team. Re-targeting the change to next maintenance window after fix. Will post follow-up with timeline. :thanks:
